# Vendored `@kieksme/mcp-http-kit`

`kieksme-mcp-http-kit-0.1.0.tgz` is a locally packed build of
[kieksme/mcp-http-kit](https://github.com/kieksme/mcp-http-kit) `0.1.0`.

The package was not yet published to the npm registry when this server migrated.
Replace the `file:vendor/...` dependency in `package.json` with
`@kieksme/mcp-http-kit@^0.1.0` (or later) once it is published, then remove this
tarball.
